resources.string: Personal preview: detects foreground apps to block your selections. In Android Settings only, reads visible labels to recognize Lockout Gate Preview\'s own Accessibility page and return you Home while protection is on. Other apps\' settings stay accessible. No screen text is saved or transmitted. Pause protection inside the app before changing its Accessibility service.

Lockout Gate detects the foreground app to enforce your blocking choices and Keep Me Out.

This personal preview also reads labels inside Android Settings to recognize its own Accessibility page and return you Home while protection is on. It leaves Wispr Flow and other apps' settings alone. It does not inspect other apps' screen contents, save these labels or transmit them. Pause protection inside Lockout Gate before changing its Accessibility service. Uninstall and other Android Settings remain accessible.

Your app list and habits stay on your phone. Keep Me Out sends a device identifier and lock requests to your configured server.

Personal preview: while protection is on, opening this app\'s own Accessibility settings returns you Home. Android Settings labels are inspected locally for this purpose. Other apps\' pages and uninstall remain available. Pause protection inside this app before changing its Accessibility service. This feature is excluded from the release intended for Google Play.
